info.name: Slot Game Backend — Complete HTTP API
info.description:
All 71 HTTP method/path contracts from src/transports/http.js, with titled requests, role and payload descriptions, response-shape examples and token/version capture. Generated 14 October 2026.

Import this JSON, set collection variables baseUrl/storeId/username/password, then run Store administrator login. Collection Bearer authentication is inherited; health and login/refresh/logout are noauth. HQ requests use hqAccessToken. Keep secrets in private/local variable values.

GET responses, registration responses and mutations capture the versions used by subsequent requests. Refresh versions after other clients change records. A machineSettings empty array means version 0; a config before creation is version 0.

New machines start idle and game sessions start at zero credit. Configure usage fees, register card/game/machine/device, assign paid time, then use the Socket.IO game operations described in SOCKET_API.md.

Do not run every folder as an unattended setup script: reset/delete/password/command requests are real operations. Examples are illustrative shapes, not captured live-server responses. Numeric version placeholders are intentionally unquoted in raw JSON and resolve at send time. For retries, use original eventId and body/version.

The accompanying Local environment sets baseUrl only; credentials and identifiers are collection variables to keep token/version capture effective. Existing Postman workspace files are preserved.

request.description:
Required: expectedVersion, environment, reason. Partial environment updates merge. Accepted keys: operatingPcs (0–10000), serverIp (IPv4/IPv6), storeName (1–128), timezone (up to 100 characters). All configuration writes share configVersion.

**Authorization:** STORE_OWNER or HQ_SUPER_ADMIN

**Business write envelope:** a fresh eventId is injected automatically. Optional correlationId is accepted; idempotency-key is an alternative to eventId in the body.
